sections.title: Social Determinants of Global Food Insecurity
sections.description: A detailed consideration of the nature, consequences, and causes of hunger and undernutrition internationally. Approaches are explored to bringing about change, and to formulating and implementing policies and programs at international, national, and local levels, designed to alleviate hunger and under-nutrition. Prerequisite: Graduate Students Only
